reason: Both give the same facts and dates, but A speaks more directly to me as a remote hire: it admits the firm is "going back on that arrangement", that people organised their lives around it, and that the four far-away colleagues get only four months extra, and it offers a private channel. B is slightly clearer to scan and reassures juniors, but its acknowledgement feels thinner and it adds an unsupported "good design and good people" claim.
